_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Journey Beyond#000.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Journey Beyond#000.dst: 到 [{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 {p} 加入 Elphaba 的任務。

A Journey Beyond#001.src: ...Hm? Oh- uh, hello there. Sorry, we have this space reserved for...
A Journey Beyond#001.dst: ……嗯？喔——呃，你好。抱歉，這個位子我們留給……
A Journey Beyond#001.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#002.src: Wait. You might be just what we're looking for. You look like you're capable in combat. How would you like to join a dangerous top secret mission?
A Journey Beyond#002.dst: 等等。你說不定正是我們要找的人。你看起來很能打。想不想加入一場危險的最高機密任務？
A Journey Beyond#002.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#003.src: ...I could have phrased that better. Look, the point is- we need a fourth. Let me give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#003.dst: ……我剛剛可以講得更好一點。聽著，重點是——我們需要第四個人。我把任務簡報講給你聽，如果你不想加入……那我們再找別人。這樣可以嗎？好，來，跟我走。
A Journey Beyond#003.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#004.src: And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
A Journey Beyond#004.dst: 這是誰？你真的找到第四個人了？拜託，我說過我們不需要！
A Journey Beyond#004.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#005.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is... sorry. I didn't catch your name. {u}? .
A Journey Beyond#005.dst: 而我們兩個一直在跟你說你哪裡錯了。這位是……抱歉，我沒聽到你的名字。{u}？
A Journey Beyond#005.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#006.src: ... {u}, is that you? Wow, it's been a while. Sorry, I don't have time to chat right now. We're preparing for a dangerous mission, and...
A Journey Beyond#006.dst: ……{u}，是你嗎？哇，好久不見。抱歉，我現在沒空聊天。我們正在準備一場危險的任務，而且……
A Journey Beyond#006.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#007.src: Well. Actually, we were looking for a fourth person to join us. And... you look like you fit the requirements for that position. If- if you'd like to join, that is.
A Journey Beyond#007.dst: 嗯。其實，我們正在找第四個人加入。而且……你看起來符合那個位置的條件。如果——如果你願意加入的話。
A Journey Beyond#007.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#008.src: Tell you what. I'll give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#008.dst: 這樣吧。我把簡報講給你聽，如果你不想加入……那我們再找別人。這樣可以嗎？好，來，跟我走。
A Journey Beyond#008.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#009.src: And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
A Journey Beyond#009.dst: 這是誰？你真的找到第四個人了？拜託，我說過我們不需要！
A Journey Beyond#009.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#010.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is {u}, we've worked together before.
A Journey Beyond#010.dst: 而我們兩個一直在跟你說你哪裡錯了。這位是 {u}，我們以前合作過。
A Journey Beyond#010.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#011.src: Anyway, I want to give them the briefing before we head
A Journey Beyond#011.dst: 總之，我想在出發之前先把簡報跟他們說清楚——
A Journey Beyond#011.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#012.src: Elphie, I'm back! I finally managed to catch Aegis, but he's not... happy. He thinks we should
A Journey Beyond#012.dst: Elphie，我回來了！我終於逮到 Aegis 了，可是他不太……高興。他認為我們應該——
A Journey Beyond#012.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#013.src: Oh. {u}? What are you doing here? Gods, it's been a while, hasn't it?
A Journey Beyond#013.dst: 喔。{u}？你怎麼會在這裡？天啊，好久不見了對吧？
A Journey Beyond#013.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#014.src: They're our fourth. What were you saying about the Admiral?
A Journey Beyond#014.dst: 他們就是我們的第四個人。你剛剛說 Admiral 怎麼了？
A Journey Beyond#014.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#016.src: Nothing. If we have our fourth, we should be all set to go, shouldn't we?
A Journey Beyond#016.dst: 沒事。第四個人到齊了，我們應該可以出發了吧？
A Journey Beyond#016.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#017.src: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.
A Journey Beyond#017.dst: 嗯……是可以，但我想先把細節講清楚。這是一場危險的任務，所以……我覺得最好讓他們知道全部。
A Journey Beyond#017.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#018.src: So! You're aware of the {p}, yes? Hundreds of years ago, mining operations took place to extract emeralds from the earth. Until, for some unknown reason, they were halted.
A Journey Beyond#018.dst: 那麼！你知道 {p} 吧？幾百年前，那裡曾經有開採作業，從地底挖出綠寶石。直到某個不明的原因，一切被叫停了。
A Journey Beyond#018.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#019.src: We don't know everything, but... evidence suggests they broke through to an undiscovered section of the Wynn province. There, they found... something.
A Journey Beyond#019.dst: 我們不知道全部的細節，但……證據顯示他們挖穿了一段從未有人發現的 Wynn 行省地帶。在那裡，他們找到了……某種東西。
A Journey Beyond#019.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#020.src: The land itself was said to be cursed. Not corrupted they were very clear on that.
A Journey Beyond#020.dst: 據說那片土地本身就受了詛咒。不是腐敗——這一點他們寫得非常清楚。
A Journey Beyond#020.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#021.src: Some other force makes its home in that place. The few reports we could find refer to it only as the Silent Expanse.
A Journey Beyond#021.dst: 有另一種力量在那裡安家。我們能找到的少數幾份報告只用一個名字稱呼它：Silent Expanse。
A Journey Beyond#021.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#022.src: The mines were sealed to prevent the spread of this new threat, but the cracks are beginning to show.
A Journey Beyond#022.dst: 礦坑被封起來，為的是阻止這個新威脅擴散，但裂縫已經開始出現了。
A Journey Beyond#022.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#023.src: Strange and otherworldly creatures have begun to find their way through, threatening our province.
A Journey Beyond#023.dst: 有些奇異的、不屬於這個世界的生物開始找到出路，威脅到我們的行省。
A Journey Beyond#023.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#024.src: The existence of this place has been kept on a strict need-to-know basis.
A Journey Beyond#024.dst: 這個地方的存在一直被列為最高機密，只有必要的人才知道。
A Journey Beyond#024.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#025.src: That's where we come in! We're to battle our way through the mines, and scout out the potential danger level.
A Journey Beyond#025.dst: 那就是我們上場的時候了！我們要一路打進礦坑，探明潛在的危險程度。
A Journey Beyond#025.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#026.src: And we aren't going to be able to do it if we keep sitting around! The newbie's been briefed, let's get going already!
A Journey Beyond#026.dst: 再這樣坐著我們什麼都做不成！新人簡報也聽完了，快走吧！
A Journey Beyond#026.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#027.src: H-hey! What're you doing to my fine establishment!
A Journey Beyond#027.dst: 喂——喂！你們對我這間好好的店做了什麼！
A Journey Beyond#027.speaker: Rusty Bartender

A Journey Beyond#028.src: ...Shoot. Forgot he was still here. Sorry, barkeep! I'll fix it!
A Journey Beyond#028.dst: ……糟。忘記他還在。抱歉啦老闆！我會修好的！
A Journey Beyond#028.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#029.src: Lucio, you can't keep... ugh, forget it. I'll gather our supplies... Aledar, can you get us to the mines?
A Journey Beyond#029.dst: Lucio，你不能老是這樣……唉，算了。我去把補給集合起來……Aledar，你能帶我們到礦坑嗎？
A Journey Beyond#029.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#030.src: Yes, ma'am! {u}, when you're ready, let's get going.
A Journey Beyond#030.dst: 是，長官！{u}，你準備好我們就出發。
A Journey Beyond#030.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#031.src: Follow your team towards the Silent Expanse's entrance.
A Journey Beyond#031.dst: 跟著隊伍前往 Silent Expanse 的入口。

A Journey Beyond#032.dst: 大家都準備好了嗎？我帶路。
A Journey Beyond#032.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#033.src: It's a twist of fate that our paths have converged here, {u}. We started our journey together and now...
A Journey Beyond#033.dst: 我們的路會在這裡交會，也算是命運的安排，{u}。我們一起踏上旅程，而現在……
A Journey Beyond#033.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#036.src: Ah, no problem. I'll take care of these.
A Journey Beyond#036.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#037.src: No more running for us, huh ? Ah, we're here.
A Journey Beyond#037.dst: 我們不用再跑了，對吧？啊，到了。
A Journey Beyond#037.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#038.src: This is actually our second attempt. The first time, it didn't go too well.
A Journey Beyond#038.dst: 其實這是我們第二次來。第一次結果不太好。
A Journey Beyond#038.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#039.src: We have more numbers now, Lucio and yourself should help us overpower it.
A Journey Beyond#039.dst: 現在我們人多了，Lucio 和你應該能幫我們壓制住它。
A Journey Beyond#039.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#040.src: Can't be that strong, bet I can take it myself.
A Journey Beyond#040.dst: 能有多強啊，我打賭我一個人就搞定。
A Journey Beyond#040.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#041.src: We managed to seal it in but with the {~} of us I'm sure we ca-
A Journey Beyond#041.dst: 我們上次好歹把它封在裡面了，現在有我們 {~} 個人，我相信我們可以——
A Journey Beyond#041.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#045.src: What's the big deal? You said yourself we can take it!
A Journey Beyond#045.dst: 有什麼大不了的？你自己說我們打得贏！
A Journey Beyond#045.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#055.src: Is it just me or are our attacks doing NOTHING?
A Journey Beyond#055.dst: 是我的錯覺嗎，還是我們的攻擊根本一點用都沒有？
A Journey Beyond#055.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#056.src: Lucio's right! Change of plan. Lucio, help me hold it in place.
A Journey Beyond#056.dst: Lucio 說得對！改變計畫。Lucio，幫我把它固定住。
A Journey Beyond#056.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#057.src: Aledar, you know what to do.
A Journey Beyond#057.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#058.src: {u}, come with me! Cast a spell to block the cave's entrance so the monster can't leave.
A Journey Beyond#058.dst: {u}，跟我來！施一個法術把洞口封住，別讓那隻怪物跑出去。
A Journey Beyond#058.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#059.src: I'll block it from attacking, you block it up with a spell.
A Journey Beyond#059.dst: 我來擋住它的攻擊，你用法術把出口堵起來。
A Journey Beyond#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#060.src: They won't be able to hold it for long.
A Journey Beyond#060.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#061.dst: 準備好了嗎？！隨便施一個法術！
A Journey Beyond#061.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#063.src: Plan a way of killing the beast.
A Journey Beyond#063.dst: 想出殺死那隻野獸的辦法。

A Journey Beyond#066.src: Phew, here. Let me get you out.
A Journey Beyond#066.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#067.src: I'm sorry, team. I've never seen a monster like that before.
A Journey Beyond#067.dst: 對不起，各位。我從來沒見過那種怪物。
A Journey Beyond#067.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#068.src: It looks like our problem isn't fire power. It's something else. It's like our weapons just didn't affect it at all.
A Journey Beyond#068.dst: 看樣子我們的問題不是火力，是別的東西。我們的武器好像對它完全沒有作用。
A Journey Beyond#068.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#069.src: I know someone who might be able to help us. A blacksmith on {p}.
A Journey Beyond#069.dst: 我知道有個人也許幫得上忙。{p} 上的一位鐵匠。
A Journey Beyond#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#070.src: {u}, I've written the house's coordinates on your book. Meet us there.
A Journey Beyond#070.dst: {u}，我把那間屋子的座標寫在你的書上了。我們在那裡會合。
A Journey Beyond#070.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#072.src: Just in time. We're all here.
A Journey Beyond#072.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#073.src: It looks like the Blacksmith knows what's wrong...
A Journey Beyond#073.dst: 看樣子鐵匠知道問題出在哪……
A Journey Beyond#073.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#074.src: So, Dren. Do you know why we can't damage the beast?
A Journey Beyond#074.dst: 那麼，Dren。你知道我們為什麼傷不了那隻野獸嗎？
A Journey Beyond#074.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#075.src: Certainly! Your issue is elemental. As you know, there are {~} elements...
A Journey Beyond#075.dst: 當然！你們的問題出在元素。你們都知道，元素有 {~} 種……
A Journey Beyond#075.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#081.src: But.. There is a hidden element, ❂Darkness..
A Journey Beyond#081.dst: 但是……還有一個隱藏的元素，❂黑暗。
A Journey Beyond#081.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#082.src: In order to damage a creature of Darkness, you must remove that influence from your soul.
A Journey Beyond#082.dst: 要傷害一隻黑暗生物，你必須先把那份影響從自己的靈魂裡除掉。
A Journey Beyond#082.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#083.src: Some Dark creatures use a sort of synchronous barrier that prevents them being harmed by other creatures influenced with Darkness.
A Journey Beyond#083.dst: 有些黑暗生物會張開一種同調屏障，讓同樣受黑暗影響的生物傷不了牠們。
A Journey Beyond#083.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#084.src: In order to purify you, I will need {~} powerful items.
A Journey Beyond#084.dst: 為了淨化你們，我需要 {~} 件強大的物品。
A Journey Beyond#084.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#085.src: Firstly, a shard from a Dernic Beast. There is one living in the depths of the {p}.
A Journey Beyond#085.dst: 首先，一片 Dernic Beast 的碎片。{p} 的深處就住著一隻。
A Journey Beyond#085.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#086.src: I will use this to reveal the darkness element in you all.
A Journey Beyond#086.dst: 我要用它把你們每個人身上的黑暗元素顯現出來。
A Journey Beyond#086.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#087.src: And then, of course, a Light item, to purify all of you...
A Journey Beyond#087.dst: 然後，當然還要一件光之物品，用來淨化你們所有人……
A Journey Beyond#087.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#088.src: Wait... what do you mean a Light item?
A Journey Beyond#088.dst: 等等……你說光之物品是什麼意思？
A Journey Beyond#088.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#089.src: Something from any Light creature would work, you could get some dust from Gavel faries if you wanted...
A Journey Beyond#089.dst: 任何光之生物身上的東西都可以，你們想的話，去弄一些 Gavel 精靈的粉塵也行……
A Journey Beyond#089.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#090.src: Alright. Aledar, you get the darkness item with {u}, and I'll go get the Light item with Lucio.
A Journey Beyond#090.dst: 好。Aledar，你跟 {u} 去拿黑暗的物品，我跟 Lucio 去拿光的物品。
A Journey Beyond#090.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#092.dst: 跟 Aledar 一起取得碎片。

A Journey Beyond#093.src: Here we are, the roots of Corruption. Let's go, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#093.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#094.src: We found that the caves around the roots are far more complex than we thought...
A Journey Beyond#094.dst: 我們發現這些根周圍的洞穴比想像中複雜得多……
A Journey Beyond#094.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#095.src: There's one with far more powerful creatures... Somewhere... Here!
A Journey Beyond#095.dst: 其中有一個裡面的生物強得多……在某個地方……在這裡！
A Journey Beyond#095.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#096.src: What are you waiting for? Let's go!
A Journey Beyond#096.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#097.src: I don't think we can spell our way across, {u}! We need something like... Wings!
A Journey Beyond#097.dst: 我不覺得我們能靠法術過去，{u}！我們需要像是……翅膀那種東西！
A Journey Beyond#097.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#098.src: I've never used wings like this before...
A Journey Beyond#098.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#099.src: I think if we just hold them and walk normally, it should help us glide across.
A Journey Beyond#099.dst: 我想只要拿著它、照平常走，應該就能滑過去。
A Journey Beyond#099.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#100.src: Don't drop them and don't get hit by the lava geysers, obviously.
A Journey Beyond#100.dst: 別鬆手，也別被岩漿噴泉打到，這還用說。
A Journey Beyond#100.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#101.src: Don't forget why we are here, we're looking for a creature of darkness. Shout for me if you find one.
A Journey Beyond#101.dst: 別忘了我們來做什麼，我們要找的是一隻黑暗生物。找到就喊我。
A Journey Beyond#101.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#102.src: Go deeper into the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the Shard.

A Journey Beyond#103.src: That's our target! Go after it!
A Journey Beyond#103.dst: 那就是我們的目標！追上去！
A Journey Beyond#103.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#104.src: Wait, why isn't it fighting us here? Careful! It might be trapped!
A Journey Beyond#104.dst: 等等，牠為什麼不在這裡反擊？小心！牠可能被困住了！
A Journey Beyond#104.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#105.src: Chase the beast for the Shard.

A Journey Beyond#106.src: Kill the Progenitors to open up the entrance.
A Journey Beyond#106.dst: 擊殺 Progenitor 打開入口。

A Journey Beyond#107.src: Kill the Mangled Progeny for the [{~} Corrupted Pearl].
A Journey Beyond#107.dst: 擊殺 Mangled Progeny 取得 [{~} Corrupted Pearl]。

A Journey Beyond#108.src: Wow, I'm impressed . I honestly thought you would need my help.
A Journey Beyond#108.dst: 哇，我服了。我還真以為你會需要我幫忙。
A Journey Beyond#108.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#109.src: Well, we got what we came for. Let's head back to Dren.
A Journey Beyond#109.dst: 好啦，該拿的都拿到了。回去找 Dren 吧。
A Journey Beyond#109.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#110.src: Return to the Blacksmith with the Darkness Item.
A Journey Beyond#110.dst: 帶著黑暗物品回去找鐵匠。

A Journey Beyond#111.src: Looks like we lucked out on this one. Did you get an item of darkness?
A Journey Beyond#111.dst: 看樣子這次我們運氣不錯。黑暗的物品拿到了嗎？
A Journey Beyond#111.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#112.src: That should do it. Let's see if this will work. Come here !
A Journey Beyond#112.dst: 這樣應該就夠了。來看看有沒有用。過來這裡！
A Journey Beyond#112.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#113.src: It's done! You ought to be free of the dark influence. You ought to be able to break through that barrier that was giving you trouble.
A Journey Beyond#113.dst: 好了！你們身上的黑暗影響應該已經去掉了。那個一直擋著你們的屏障，現在應該打得穿了。
A Journey Beyond#113.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#114.src: Are you sure? I don't feel that different. Well... I guess there's only one way to find out.
A Journey Beyond#114.dst: 你確定嗎？我沒覺得有什麼不同。嗯……我想只有一個辦法能知道。
A Journey Beyond#114.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#115.src: Re-open the closed entrance with the other warriors.
A Journey Beyond#115.dst: 與其他戰士一起重新打開封住的入口。

A Journey Beyond#116.src: Everyone here? Great! Time to finish what I started!
A Journey Beyond#116.dst: 大家都到了嗎？很好！該把我開的頭收尾了！
A Journey Beyond#116.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#117.src: Lucio! No! When will you learn?
A Journey Beyond#117.dst: Lucio！不要！你什麼時候才學得乖？
A Journey Beyond#117.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#118.src: Right, yes. Sorry, what's the plan?
A Journey Beyond#118.dst: 好啦好啦。抱歉，計畫是什麼？
A Journey Beyond#118.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#119.src: We don't want that thing to escape, it could cause widespread panic.
A Journey Beyond#119.dst: 我們不能讓那東西跑出去，會引起大規模恐慌的。
A Journey Beyond#119.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#120.src: We'll open up a small entrance to get in, and fight it once inside.
A Journey Beyond#120.dst: 我們只開一個小入口進去，進去之後再打。
A Journey Beyond#120.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#126.src: We have an extremely old map of the mines to help us, but we have no idea what's waiting for us.
A Journey Beyond#126.dst: 我們手上有一張非常舊的礦坑地圖可以參考，但完全不知道裡面等著我們的是什麼。
A Journey Beyond#126.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#127.src: I want to warn you, this may well be a one way ticket for all of us.
A Journey Beyond#127.dst: 我要先提醒你們，這很可能是我們所有人的單程票。
A Journey Beyond#127.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#129.src: Rocks are one thing, Lucio. The creatures we're about to face require more than brute strength. You need force of mind.
A Journey Beyond#129.dst: 石頭是一回事，Lucio。我們接下來要面對的生物，光靠蠻力是不夠的。你需要的是意志力。
A Journey Beyond#129.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#130.src: Oh my. Maybe this isn't the best idea.
A Journey Beyond#130.dst: 我的天。也許這不是什麼好主意。
A Journey Beyond#130.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#131.src: It's too late now. We've got to finish this mission.
A Journey Beyond#131.dst: 現在說這些太遲了。這個任務我們非完成不可。
A Journey Beyond#131.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#133.src: Remember the goal Elphie, we must reach the end of the expanse.
A Journey Beyond#133.dst: 別忘了目標，Elphie，我們必須抵達這片區域的盡頭。
A Journey Beyond#133.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#134.src: It's still empty here. But it looks like they were here only yesterday.
A Journey Beyond#134.dst: 這裡還是空的。可是看起來他們昨天才剛離開。
A Journey Beyond#134.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#135.src: I thought you said the miners were here hundreds of years ago?
A Journey Beyond#135.dst: 你不是說那些礦工是幾百年前的人嗎？
A Journey Beyond#135.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#136.src: They were. I don't know why it would be so well presevered. It's as if nothing has touched it.
A Journey Beyond#136.dst: 是啊。我不知道為什麼會保存得這麼完好。就好像什麼都沒碰過一樣。
A Journey Beyond#136.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#137.src: According to the documents, we need to make our way to the end of the road.
A Journey Beyond#137.dst: 根據文件，我們得一路走到這條路的盡頭。
A Journey Beyond#137.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#139.src: So much for nothing being here.
A Journey Beyond#139.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#140.src: Why are they only going for me?
A Journey Beyond#140.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#141.src: Aledar, how far is it to the end?
A Journey Beyond#141.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#142.src: I read the same map as you. It didn't even have scale. There should be a bridge ahead, though.
A Journey Beyond#142.dst: 我看的地圖跟你一樣。上面連比例尺都沒有。不過前面應該有一座橋。
A Journey Beyond#142.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#143.src: Uhh... A destroyed one. And it wasn't cause I blew it up this time!
A Journey Beyond#143.dst: 呃……一座毀掉的橋。而且這次不是我炸的！
A Journey Beyond#143.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#144.src: Hmm, well we will have to go around.
A Journey Beyond#144.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#145.src: This doesn't really look like corruption, does it?
A Journey Beyond#145.dst: 這看起來不太像腐敗，對吧？
A Journey Beyond#145.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#146.src: Uhhh... I'm not feeling very wel-... Aahhh!
A Journey Beyond#146.dst: 呃……我覺得不太舒——……啊啊啊！
A Journey Beyond#146.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#147.src: Aaahhh! My liver! It took my liver!
A Journey Beyond#147.dst: 啊啊啊！我的肝！它拿走了我的肝！
A Journey Beyond#147.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#150.src: Aledar, maybe we should just double back now?
A Journey Beyond#150.dst: Aledar，也許我們現在就該掉頭？
A Journey Beyond#150.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#151.src: Elphaba is an extremely able warrior. We will fight on and find her.
A Journey Beyond#151.dst: Elphaba 是非常有能力的戰士。我們繼續打下去，把她找出來。
A Journey Beyond#151.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#152.src: Do you really think it was just an illusion?
A Journey Beyond#152.dst: 你真的覺得那只是幻覺嗎？
A Journey Beyond#152.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#153.src: I'm not sure. I hope so.
A Journey Beyond#153.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#154.src: What if we're infected too? Shouldn't we just go back?
A Journey Beyond#154.dst: 萬一我們也被感染了呢？我們不是該回去嗎？
A Journey Beyond#154.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#155.src: We can't, Lucio! We have a mission as you very well know. We continue.
A Journey Beyond#155.dst: 不行，Lucio！我們有任務在身，你很清楚。繼續走。
A Journey Beyond#155.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#156.src: Besides, we might be carrying some of those things too. We can't risk them infesting Wynn.
A Journey Beyond#156.dst: 何況我們身上可能也帶著那些東西。不能冒讓它們蔓延到 Wynn 的險。
A Journey Beyond#156.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#157.src: Looks like we need to go around to the right, here?
A Journey Beyond#157.dst: 看起來我們得從這裡往右繞，對吧？
A Journey Beyond#157.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#158.src: It feels like something is watching us...
A Journey Beyond#158.dst: 感覺有東西在看著我們……
A Journey Beyond#158.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#159.src: Aledar, what is this place? You didn't tell me there was a city here.
A Journey Beyond#159.dst: Aledar，這是什麼地方？你沒說過這裡有一座城。
A Journey Beyond#159.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#160.src: There is. A big one, too; there's more ahead. But it doesn't look like anyone's home . The map doesn't have a name for it either.
A Journey Beyond#160.dst: 有的。而且是很大一座；前面還有更多。不過看起來沒人在家。地圖上也沒給它名字。
A Journey Beyond#160.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#161.src: Wait a sec, is that one of the miners? Is she hurt? HEEEEY! YOU OVER THERE!
A Journey Beyond#161.dst: 等一下，那是不是其中一個礦工？她受傷了嗎？喂——！那邊那位！
A Journey Beyond#161.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#164.src: Wait, what's going on? Why can't I move?
A Journey Beyond#164.dst: 等等，怎麼回事？我為什麼動不了？
A Journey Beyond#164.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#167.src: We can't live alone like this!
A Journey Beyond#167.dst: 我們不能這樣一個人活下去！
A Journey Beyond#167.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#170.src: You need to come with us!
A Journey Beyond#170.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#171.src: It's the only way to keep you safe!
A Journey Beyond#171.dst: 只有這樣才能保你平安！
A Journey Beyond#171.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#172.src: It's the only way to make you happy here!
A Journey Beyond#172.dst: 只有這樣你在這裡才會快樂！
A Journey Beyond#172.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#173.src: It's the only way to make us feel whole!
A Journey Beyond#173.dst: 只有這樣我們才會覺得完整！
A Journey Beyond#173.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#174.src: IT'S THE ONLY WAY, DO YOU UNDERSTAND?!
A Journey Beyond#174.dst: 只有這一條路，你懂不懂？！
A Journey Beyond#174.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#175.src: AAAH! S-Stop screaming at me! I can't understand!!
A Journey Beyond#175.dst: 啊啊！別、別再對我吼了！我聽不懂！！
A Journey Beyond#175.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#178.src: CAN'T YOU HEAR WHAT I'M SAYING?
A Journey Beyond#178.dst: 你聽不見我在說什麼嗎？
A Journey Beyond#178.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#180.src: No! How did she disable my spell?!
A Journey Beyond#180.dst: 不！她怎麼有辦法解掉我的法術？！
A Journey Beyond#180.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#182.src: YOU'LL BE SO MUCH HAPPIER IF YOU COME ALONG!
A Journey Beyond#182.dst: 你跟我們走會快樂得多！
A Journey Beyond#182.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#183.src: YOU'LL NEVER HAVE TO WORRY AGAIN!
A Journey Beyond#183.dst: 你再也不用擔心任何事！
A Journey Beyond#183.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#186.src: Just please, stand still a little longer!
A Journey Beyond#186.dst: 拜託，再站著別動一下下就好！
A Journey Beyond#186.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#187.dst: 我們會帶你去溫暖的地方！
A Journey Beyond#187.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#188.src: You won't be hunted! We promise! No one hunts us!
A Journey Beyond#188.dst: 不會有人追捕你！我們保證！沒有人會追捕我們！
A Journey Beyond#188.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#190.src: THANK YOU! WE WILL GO TOGETHER!
A Journey Beyond#190.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#191.dst: 跟我們在一起你會很安全！
A Journey Beyond#191.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#192.src: NO MORE FEAR! NO MORE CONCERN!
A Journey Beyond#192.dst: 不再有恐懼！不再有煩惱！
A Journey Beyond#192.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#194.src: No no no!! This is bad, really bad! We have to go ! Quick!
A Journey Beyond#194.dst: 不不不！！這下糟了，非常糟！我們得走了！快！
A Journey Beyond#194.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#197.src: Wait, you're just one of the miners. This doesn't feel like an illusion...
A Journey Beyond#197.dst: 等等，你只是個礦工。這感覺不像幻覺……
A Journey Beyond#197.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#198.src: Look, you need to get out of here. It's not safe- Wait, what's that noise...?
A Journey Beyond#198.dst: 聽著，你得離開這裡。這裡不安全——等等，那是什麼聲音……？
A Journey Beyond#198.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#201.src: Find Aledar, Lucio and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#201.dst: 在 Fallen City 找到 Aledar、Lucio 和 Elphaba。

A Journey Beyond#202.src: {u}! She was completely right. You ought to come with us...
A Journey Beyond#202.dst: {u}！她說得完全沒錯。你也應該跟我們走……
A Journey Beyond#202.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#203.src: Find Aledar and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#203.dst: 在 Fallen City 找到 Aledar 和 Elphaba。

A Journey Beyond#204.src: Find Aledar in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#204.dst: 在 Fallen City 找到 Aledar。

A Journey Beyond#206.src: I think my leg is broken. I have a potion to fix it, but I dropped it back up there.
A Journey Beyond#206.dst: 我的腿好像斷了。我有藥水可以治，但掉在上面了。
A Journey Beyond#206.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#207.src: I feel a bit better.. But something is still wrong.
A Journey Beyond#207.dst: 感覺好一點了……但還是有哪裡不對勁。
A Journey Beyond#207.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#208.src: Let's just get out of here, soldier on. There's only one way out.
A Journey Beyond#208.dst: 我們先離開這裡，撐著點。出去只有一條路。
A Journey Beyond#208.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#211.src: Urrrgh. {u}, this hasn't gone to plan. According to my map we aren't even half way.
A Journey Beyond#211.dst: 唔……{u}，事情完全脫離計畫了。照我的地圖看，我們連一半都還沒走到。
A Journey Beyond#211.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#212.src: I can't walk. But equally we can't stay here.
A Journey Beyond#212.dst: 我走不動了。可是我們也不能待在這裡。
A Journey Beyond#212.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#213.src: The mission must be carried out. The plan has changed but it's imperative we get to the end of the expanse, together.
A Journey Beyond#213.dst: 任務一定要完成。計畫變了，但我們非得一起走到這片區域的盡頭不可。
A Journey Beyond#213.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#214.src: There has to be a way.. Even if you have to push me in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#214.dst: 一定有辦法的……就算你得用這台東西把我推過去也一樣！
A Journey Beyond#214.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#215.src: No, I'm not joking. You guard the cart, I'll lead the way.
A Journey Beyond#215.dst: 不，我沒在開玩笑。你顧著推車，我來指路。
A Journey Beyond#215.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#216.src: Escort Aledar through the {p} to {p} at ({~}, -{~}).
A Journey Beyond#216.dst: 護送 Aledar 穿過 {p} 前往 ({~1}, -{~2}) 的 {p}。

A Journey Beyond#217.src: According to the map, the miners started a town a little ahead.
A Journey Beyond#217.dst: 照地圖看，礦工在前面不遠處建了一個小鎮。
A Journey Beyond#217.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#218.src: Who knows what's left, but it's got to be safer than here.
A Journey Beyond#218.dst: 誰知道還剩下什麼，但總比這裡安全。
A Journey Beyond#218.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#219.src: I think the Small Monsters will try to Kill me.
A Journey Beyond#219.dst: 我猜小型怪物會想殺我。
A Journey Beyond#219.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#220.src: While the Big Monsters will try to Kill you.
A Journey Beyond#220.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#221.src: It's going to be on you to make sure we both get through this.
A Journey Beyond#221.dst: 能不能讓我們兩個都活著過去，就看你了。
A Journey Beyond#221.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#222.src: The fate of the mission relies on the two of us working together.
A Journey Beyond#222.dst: 任務的成敗，就靠我們兩個配合。
A Journey Beyond#222.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#223.src: Are those... Eyes on the trees?
A Journey Beyond#223.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#225.src: Watch out, the small monsters are coming for me! I can't fight in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#225.dst: 注意，小型怪物往我這邊來了！我坐在這東西上沒辦法打！
A Journey Beyond#225.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#227.src: Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
A Journey Beyond#227.dst: 幹得好！看起來牠們不來了。繼續走吧。
A Journey Beyond#227.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#229.src: Let's keep going! Before they come back.
A Journey Beyond#229.dst: 趁牠們回來之前，我們繼續走！
A Journey Beyond#229.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#230.src: A lot of those small ones are coming for me!
A Journey Beyond#230.dst: 好多小的往我這邊衝過來了！
A Journey Beyond#230.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#231.src: This one was close! We're getting close to the town.
A Journey Beyond#231.dst: 這隻好險！我們快到鎮上了。
A Journey Beyond#231.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#232.src: We'll have to stop again! We can't go past so many monsters.
A Journey Beyond#232.dst: 我們得再停一次！怪物太多了，過不去。
A Journey Beyond#232.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#233.src: We're almost there! I can see the town from here!
A Journey Beyond#233.dst: 快到了！我從這裡看得到那個鎮！
A Journey Beyond#233.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#235.src: Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
A Journey Beyond#235.dst: 幹得好！看起來牠們不來了。繼續走吧。
A Journey Beyond#235.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#236.src: Ouch! I got hit! Be careful, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#236.dst: 唉唷！我被打到了！小心點，{u}！
A Journey Beyond#236.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#237.src: Finally, we've arrived... It's not exactly the town on the map.
A Journey Beyond#237.dst: 總算到了……跟地圖上的那個鎮不太一樣。
A Journey Beyond#237.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#238.src: The lost miners are here... How? they must be hundreds of years old!
A Journey Beyond#238.dst: 失蹤的礦工都在這裡……怎麼可能？他們應該是幾百年前的人了！
A Journey Beyond#238.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#239.src: What is this obelisk? It's.. comforting. I recognise this feeling from my time in Gavel.
A Journey Beyond#239.dst: 這個方尖碑是什麼？它……讓人安心。我在 Gavel 的時候感受過這種感覺。
A Journey Beyond#239.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#240.src: Maybe.. It's been touched by the light? If so.. It could heal me.
A Journey Beyond#240.dst: 說不定……它被光碰觸過？如果是的話……它也許能治好我。
A Journey Beyond#240.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#241.src: Let's see if it does anything to me...
A Journey Beyond#241.dst: 來看看它對我有沒有用……
A Journey Beyond#241.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#242.src: It worked... Kind of. I feel at least {~}.. We still have a ways to go.
A Journey Beyond#242.dst: 有用……算是吧。我至少覺得 {~}……我們還有一段路要走。
A Journey Beyond#242.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#243.src: Let's take some time to gather ourselves before we press on. I'll meet you on the other side of town.
A Journey Beyond#243.dst: 在繼續之前，我們花點時間整頓一下。我在鎮的另一頭等你。
A Journey Beyond#243.speaker: Aledar
